value.rationale: Natural complete classification of all irredundant hitting sets refines a previously studied scalar minimum. Proves strong uniform upper bound 3 for all h, a sharp size-3 onset at h=6, and an explicit linear-vs-cubic multiplicity profile 3h versus h(h-4)(h-5)/3; the threshold is an actual purity transition and is not implied by minimum size 2.
